title: Hivemind Ledger
pitch: Every bee in your swarm IS one stat point, and you drag them between hives mid-fight to rewrite your stat sheet while raiders are biting.
howto: Fly the queen around a dusk meadow while wasps, beetles and a hornet matriarch swoop in. Rebalance the four hives live: STING is +1 attack per bee, AEGIS +1 defense, ZEPHYR +1 speed, FORAGE turns flowers into nectar into new bees. Bees that fail to block die for good, so grind honey into queen upgrades and heavy/gilded breeds for a swarm that carries across days.
controls: Tap or drag anywhere on the meadow to fly the queen. Drag from one hive cell to another (or tap A then tap B) to stream a third of that hive across. Tap II to pause or retreat.
